The actual message — *"Has anyone looked into getting supercomputer time for the circuit-tracer workload? AWS has those p5 instances now and the pricing isn't terrible for burst jobs."* — was posted by **johndoe (U02JOHNDOE1)**, not Kenji Sato, in the **#engineering** channel (C03IJKL9012) of workspace **T01WORKSPACE**.

Kenji Sato's only messages found in the workspace were unrelated: one about team food/snacks during crunch weeks, and one offering to build a JAX prototype for the circuit-tracer PyTorch rewrite effort — neither mentions supercomputer time.

So there is only one workspace accessible (T01WORKSPACE), and within it, the supercomputer-time question about circuit-tracer was asked by johndoe in #engineering, not by Kenji Sato.
